title: Nutty Norwegian Rice Flour Pancakes
description: Savory Norwegian rice flour pancakes served in a molcajete, perfect for a flexitarian brunch

ingredients.name: rice flour
ingredients.notes: preferably Norwegian short grain rice flour

instructions: Combine rice flour, all purpose flour, and salt in a large bowl
Whisk together eggs, milk, and water in a separate bowl
Add the melted butter to the egg mixture and whisk until smooth
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined
Fold in the chopped walnuts and parsley
Heat a non stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on the first side, until bubbles appear on the surface
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown
Serve the pancakes in a molcajete with your choice of toppings, such as sour cream or jam
